data.narrative:
Aeon Industrial is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Naweed Tahmas and Joe Cieslik that has raised $18.6M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies across public and private markets—2 publicly traded entities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, predominantly at Series A stage.

Two valuation methods triangulate on Aeon's worth. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-round advancement, using the $18.6M raised as a proxy baseline, yielding $46.5M. Peer-median valuation across the 4 most directly comparable same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) produces a median of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The two methods produce a wide spread. The triangulated analysis supports a range of $40M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $373M. This dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Aeon should be valued as an early-stage capital deployment ($46M) or positioned within the broader Defense & Security frontier-tech cohort, where valuations exhibit 32x variance. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, technical differentiation relative to the named peer set, and founder track record validation in this sector.
